verified_inputs.procedure: Read immutable Git objects in all four source repositories; independently compare tree IDs and every inspected path's blob ID, byte count and SHA-256. Compare all inspected non-graph nsealr paths between preparation base and adopted S01 main.

reviewed: All five parent criteria have requirement-derived positive/negative cases; source agreement is not treated as correctness or actual device qualification.
Static support, trusted local observations, exact release evidence and untrusted wire claims are separate. No descriptor, route result or readiness enum can mint S03 authority.

Four independent Signer profiles preserve explicit custody/no-SE/boot limitations; generic Board SDK has no Nostr dependency. Initial connected operation uses manual consent rather than requiring automation.
Actual Bridge dispatch intersects method, algorithm, catalog, custody, transport and finite capacities with request/session/expected-key binding and zero-write rejection cases.
Separate NIP-44 primitives, verified context and admitted NIP-17/59 workflows prevent promotion of host transport encryption or opaque signing into a usable device DM guarantee.
Compact discovery cannot increase serial capacity or substitute a peer-selected manifest for a locally trusted artifact; strict raw JSON checks supplement schema checks.
Exact A02 layout/source and S03 frozen parser/authorization API must be reconciled before code. Proposed acceptance commands are explicitly not yet implemented or executed.

resolved_before_approval.resolution: Brief, source audit and acceptance resource inventory now explicitly retain unknown/not identified hardware and operator resources. No physical measurement or resource absence is inferred.
New active device contract is nsealr.signing.v2 with numeric envelope 2. Retired v0/numeric-1 is historical only; separate inventory/capability/account revisions remain explicit.

Full/reference equality is required for representable runtime states; incomplete, unrepresentable or oversized deltas invalidate the prior route and refuse constrained discovery/operation. New independent case S-07 covers this failure without widening the transport cap. Observable route invalidation supplements the device's mandatory fresh observation at execution; an unreported device change is never trusted host consent.

implementation_authorization: The exact revised specification is approved. Product edits remain on hold until root records the reconciled actual A02 source/layout/contract artifact, frozen S03 parser/authorization API, exact input tuple and owned writable scope. limits: Preparation review only. No T01 runtime acceptance, product signing, physical property, release admission or external certification.
